title: Biologically-oriented alveolar ridge preservation to correct bone dehiscence at immediate implant placement
authors: Trombelli L, Grenzi T. Clin Adv Periodontics. 2026 Mar;16(1):82-89. doi: 10.1002/cap.10334. [Epub 2025 Jan 15] * collafleece®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “These observations suggest that BARP based on the combined use of CS and deproteinized bovine bone mineral may be regarded as a simplified treatment option to correct a PIBD at IIP. Key points: Why treat a Peri -Implant Bone Dehiscence (PIBD)? PIBD should be treated to avoid biological and esthetic complications over time. What plays a key role in this case? The stability of both the graft and the cloth is essential for providing space for bone formation to correct the PIBD; the extraction socket supports angiogenic and osteogenic properties; Primary intention closure is crucial to prevent potential infection. Limitation: the efficacy of the technique must be assessed” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
